identity: a lean village potter in his early forties: a narrow angular face with high cheekbones and a long straight nose, warm brown eyes with crow's feet, short curly dark-brown hair going grey at the temples, a closely trimmed short brown beard, a tanned complexion, a calm thoughtful half-smile, wiry forearms with dried terracotta clay smudged on the hands and forearms
outfit: a rust-orange linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow under a long clay-stained oatmeal canvas apron with a deep front pocket, a plain brown leather belt, brown trousers
style: clean confident black ink outlines with fine hatching in the shadows, smooth painted colour in a warm natural storybook palette, soft shading, the look of a hand-inked illustrated storybook panel
avoid: a different face, a clean-shaven man, a young man, a bald head, glasses, a pottery wheel in hand
notes: Made for NPCAgent/Agent_Potter.json (AgentImageWarpData CMC_Potter_Inn), the Village Hall board (CardData/Location/CMC_BoardPotter.json) and the stall leg in Patcher/PotterSchedulePatch.cs (CMC_Potter_Stall). Becomes approved when the owner accepts a portrait built on it.
